articles.title: Mint: Rose Engine

Up close: Warm khaki-grey, like stone or suede, with a very soft diamond-shaped mottle about 100 px across made of darker and lighter clouds. Fine wavy ripple lines, 3-5 px apart, run across it diagonally, and tiny bright specks sit here and there. No rosettes, circles or engraved lines are readable. From a distance: Reads as a plain warm taupe-grey, slightly cloudy and sandy; the ripples vanish and only a gentle diamond-like blotchiness stays. Measured spec (average): metal 68, roughness 99, coat 97. Shine: satin. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.

articles.summary: Near-black deep blue with a faint fine grid, dull and matte, no glow at all. Near-black blue-grey with a faint pale grid; at distance only the vertical threads show, a subtle pinstripe on a dark car.
articles.what: Perfect in daylight. Under the lamp at the till, the fibres that should light up stay black. Up close: Dark navy-charcoal field of fine horizontal scan-lines with static, crossed by thin pale blue-grey vertical threads about 40 px apart that lean slightly off vertical, and a few brighter dots where they cross horizontal bands. Like a security thread grid on a blacked-out screen. From a distance: Near-black blue-grey with a faint pale grid; at distance only the vertical threads show, a subtle pinstripe on a dark car. Measured spec (average): metal 41, roughness 117, coat 111. Shine: satin. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.
